title: Tender Monitoring Dashboard — data dictionary
notes: Source columns are preserved exactly (labels, order, blanks). Duplicate headers receive internal keys with _1, _2 suffixes; the original header text is displayed and exported.
Standard fields are an analytical mapping layer. Mappings can be changed per worksheet layout under Settings → Column mapping.
Calculated fields are never written into source columns. They can optionally be exported as extra "[Calc]" columns.
Dates: dd/mm/yyyy and dd-mm-yyyy (default reading when both parts ≤ 12), mm/dd/yyyy only when the day part is > 12, "31 Aug 2026", ISO, and Excel serial numbers in date columns.

standardFields.label: SR No
standardFields.description: Serial number of the row in the tracker.

standardFields.label: Procurement Channel (P&CS / CPO)
standardFields.description: Procurement channel handling the tender (P&CS or CPO).

standardFields.label: Department
standardFields.description: Owning department (e.g. INSTR, ELECTRICAL).

standardFields.label: CAPEX / REVEX
standardFields.description: Budget head: CAPEX or REVEX.

standardFields.label: Tender Initiator
standardFields.description: Person who initiated the tender.

standardFields.label: WBS No
standardFields.description: SAP WBS element (CAPEX). Kept as text.

standardFields.label: Project Cost
standardFields.description: Sanctioned project cost (unit per header or Settings; default lakh).

standardFields.label: BE (Budget Estimate)
standardFields.description: Budget estimate for the financial year.

standardFields.label: CAPEX Finish Date
standardFields.description: Target date for completion of CAPEX.

standardFields.label: PR No
standardFields.description: Purchase requisition number (first PR No column). Kept as text.

standardFields.label: PR No (2nd column)
standardFields.description: Second "PR No" column in the CAPEX tracker (duplicate header retained).

standardFields.label: PR Sent Date
standardFields.description: Date the PR was sent.

standardFields.label: Proposal Name
standardFields.description: Name of the CAPEX proposal.

standardFields.label: Job Description
standardFields.description: Description of the job / supply.

standardFields.label: STATUS
standardFields.description: Free-text status as maintained by the user. Never overwritten.

standardFields.label: CRFQ / GeM ID
standardFields.description: CRFQ number or GeM bid ID. Kept as text.

standardFields.label: Sent to Concerned CPO/P&CS
standardFields.description: Date (or note) when sent to the concerned CPO / P&CS.

standardFields.label: Tender Floating Date
standardFields.description: Date the tender was floated.

standardFields.label: Tender Floating Duration (days)
standardFields.description: Source value: tender floating duration in days.

standardFields.label: Pre-Bid Meeting Date
standardFields.description: Pre-bid meeting date.

standardFields.label: Tender / Bid Opening Date
standardFields.description: Scheduled tender / bid opening date.

standardFields.label: Actual Tender Opening Date
standardFields.description: Actual tender opening date.

standardFields.label: BQC & Technical Evaluation Date
standardFields.description: BQC & technical evaluation completion date.

standardFields.label: Technical Evaluation Duration (days)
standardFields.description: Source value: technical evaluation duration in days.

standardFields.label: Price Bid Opened On
standardFields.description: Date the price bid was opened.

standardFields.label: TEC Approval Date
standardFields.description: Tender Evaluation Committee approval date.

standardFields.label: FAT
standardFields.description: Factory Acceptance Test date or status.

standardFields.label: SAT
standardFields.description: Site Acceptance Test date or status.

standardFields.label: Installation
standardFields.description: Installation / commissioning date or status.

standardFields.label: PO / OLA No
standardFields.description: PO / OLA number. Kept as text.

standardFields.label: PO / OLA Award Date
standardFields.description: PO / OLA award date.

standardFields.label: PR to PO Cycle (days)
standardFields.description: Source value: PR-to-PO cycle in days.

standardFields.label: SLA
standardFields.description: Service level / delivery terms.

standardFields.label: PO / OLA Validity
standardFields.description: PO / OLA validity (expiry) date.

standardFields.label: Cash Outflow (incl. tax)
standardFields.description: PO / OLA value including tax (default rupees).

standardFields.label: Cash Outflow (excl. tax)
standardFields.description: PO / OLA value excluding tax (default rupees).

standardFields.label: PO / OLA Cash Outflow
standardFields.description: PO / OLA cash outflow (default rupees).

standardFields.label: Vendor
standardFields.description: Successful vendor / contractor.

standardFields.label: Remarks
standardFields.description: Remarks column (REVEX).

standardFields.label: Remarks (if any)
standardFields.description: Remarks (if any).

standardFields.label: Nature
standardFields.description: Nature of work (Supply / Service / Works / Rate contract).

standardFields.label: Estimated Cost
standardFields.description: Estimated cost (header states unit, e.g. In Lacs).

standardFields.label: Project Handing Over
standardFields.description: Project handing-over date or status.

standardFields.label: Days Since Float (source)
standardFields.description: Source snapshot: days since float (Capex Modified).

standardFields.label: Days to Opening (source)
standardFields.description: Source snapshot: days to opening (Capex Modified).

standardFields.label: Status Flag
standardFields.description: Source status flag (Capex Modified).

standardFields.label: Quick Status
standardFields.description: Source quick status (Capex Modified).

calculatedFields.description: Rules-based lifecycle stage (see stages). Structured dates first; STATUS / Quick Status / Remarks text as supporting evidence; manual override possible in Edit Mode.
Explanation of how the stage was determined, including any data conflict.
Delayed when any delay alert applies (thresholds in Settings); Closed for completed / cancelled / scrapped / on hold.
Next expected step for the current stage, with its planned date when known.
